1.explanation: These documents are necessary because they contain the implementation and documentation of the CascaderSelect component, including the search functionality. The demo files provide examples of how the search feature is intended to work, which is crucial for understanding and reproducing the issue. The main component files will help identify where the search results are managed and how they can be cleared or reset.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs in the CascaderSelect component where, after searching and selecting all results, the search results are not cleared. Users remain on the search results page and are unsure how to return to the full list. The only way to return is by clicking outside the dropdown to close it and then reopening it.
